mapper.sql: s.id, s.user_id, s.branch_name, s.stage, s.applicant_date, s.applicant_ref, s.activist_date, s.activist_ref, s.candidate_date, s.candidate_ref, s.probationary_date, s.probationary_ref, s.full_date, s.full_ref, s.internal_note, s.internal_discussion, s.stage_publicity_id, s.rollback_reason, s.rollback_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no, sp.class_name AS class_name
FROM party_stage s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = s.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.branch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_stage (user_id, branch_name, stage, applicant_date, applicant_ref, activist_date, activist_ref, candidate_date, candidate_ref, probationary_date, probationary_ref, full_date, full_ref, internal_note, internal_discussion, stage_publicity_id, rollback_reason, rollback_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{branchName}, #{stage}, #{applicantDate}, #{applicantRef}, #{activistDate}, #{activistRef}, #{candidateDate}, #{candidateRef}, #{probationaryDate}, #{probationaryRef}, #{fullDate}, #{fullRef}, #{internalNote}, #{internalDiscussion}, #{stagePublicityId}, #{rollbackReason}, #{rollbackAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE party_stage SET
applicant_date = #{stepDate}, applicant_ref = #{stepRef},
activist_date = #{stepDate}, activist_ref = #{stepRef},
candidate_date = #{stepDate}, candidate_ref = #{stepRef},
probationary_date = #{stepDate}, probationary_ref = #{stepRef},
full_date = #{stepDate}, full_ref = #{stepRef},
stage = #{toStage}, branch_name = COALESCE(#{branchName}, branch_name), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stage = #{fromStage}
UPDATE party_stage SET stage_publicity_id = #{publicityId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stage = #{stage}

UPDATE party_stage SET branch_name = COALESCE(#{branchName}, branch_name), internal_note = #{internalNote}, internal_discussion = #{internalDiscussion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stage = #{stage}
UPDATE party_stage SET stage = #{toStage}, rollback_reason = #{reason}, rollback_at = #{at}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stage = #{fromStage}
mapper.select: SELECT s.stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_stage s WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.stage ORDER BY s.stage
SELECT s.branch_name AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_stage s WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.branch_name ORDER BY s.branch_name
